construction_materials.expansion: X <Sector> Expansion = Desired Expansion x Min(X Capital Goods Fulfillment, X Construction Materials Fulfillment) for Refinery / Electronics / Power in A and B
construction_materials.not_in_v7_7: regolith extraction energy, interregional trade, lifecycle of the new sectors other than the plants and the regolith mine
construction_materials.known_limit: colony B builds only under stimulus; Mode 31 (transport surge) is the Mode in which B produces construction materials (Mode 30: B only draws its starting stock)
construction_materials.transport: since v7.7.1 shared Transport expansion = Desired x Min(Transport CG Fulfillment, Transport CM Fulfillment), drawing construction materials from A and B by stock shares (switch Transport Construction Materials Enabled)
construction_materials.energy: since v7.7.2 construction-materials processing is the third consumer of the colony energy allocator (switch Construction Materials Energy Enabled); the plan feeding the allocator reads the smoothed stock X Construction Materials Demand Signal (same-step demand closed an algebraic loop through refinery profit)
construction_materials.capital: since v7.7.3 processing capacity is capital: a kernel-v2 construction-materials plant per colony (no finance limit), sized to the smoothed demand signal, expanded from capital goods and construction materials (switch Construction Materials Capital Enabled)

planet_v1.counters: processes 17 + legacy 2; P2 11/2/4/0 (kernel/simple/exceptions/undeclared); P3 6/2/9/0; P4 0/6; P5 4/13; P6 4; reversibility 0

capital_goods_capital.plant: kernel-v2 capital-goods plant per colony, no finance limit, sized to the smoothed X Capital Goods Demand Signal stock; expansion from capital goods and construction materials

regolith_capital.mine: simple-capital regolith mine per colony, sized to the smoothed X Regolith Demand Signal stock x 1.25; expansion from capital goods and construction materials; depreciation and retirement of surplus
